human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Define the source-neutral contract that EverRun and later runtimes can emit: package manifest, event envelope, provenance metadata, artifact references, event vocabulary conventions, coverage accounting, and deterministic identity. Keep event_type extensible. Dependency: 8002.record-evidence-projection-adr.
human_pressure.why_now: Ailuros should own the contract semantics while individual runtimes own native-to-contract adapters.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create the canonical Ailuros runtime evidence package v1 contract without EverRun-specific core fields.
invariants: Depends on: 8002.record-evidence-projection-adr. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Package run identity is preserved end-to-end.
contracts: Source runtime adapters map native evidence into this package.
Ailuros consumes only this contract or native Ailuros runtime events.
failure_semantics: Malformed required contract fields fail validation; valid unknown event types remain preservable.

steps.title: Define package envelope
details: source, schema_version, run_id, metadata, events, files/artifact refs.

steps.title: Define provenance
details: source_event_type, source_artifact, source_pointer, optional pack/iteration/role context.
Do not require these optional dimensions for every runtime.

steps.title: Define event naming conventions
details: Extensible dotted names with a small recommended neutral vocabulary.
No central closed enum for all runtime-specific evidence.

acceptance: Contract is source-neutral and usable by EverRun without importing Ailuros Python code.
Provenance and deterministic identity are normative.
Unknown preserved evidence is distinct from valid/clean governance result.

must_check: Contract can express EverRun evidence without naming EverRun-private files as core types.
No closed universal event enum is introduced.
reject_if: Contract requires every runtime to implement planner/coder/judge concepts.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
